name: Do tankless water heaters require special venting?

mainEntity.name: Do tankless water heaters require special venting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, tankless water heaters often require specific venting solutions that differ from traditional tank heaters due to their higher efficiency and direct venting capabilities. Many models use PVC or stainless steel venting, which must be installed according to manufacturer specifications and local codes. Proper venting ensures safe operation and maximum efficiency. Our technicians are trained in the correct installation of various venting systems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, tankless water heaters require specific venting solutions, often PVC or stainless steel, installed according to manufacturer specs and local codes.
